_comment: RUCKUS Analytics (MLISA) Data Studio catalog. Harvested from a live NA tenant 2026-09-22: metrics/dims/labels/metric_sql from /api/v1/dataset/<id>, dataset_uuid mined from a 19-dashboard export. Identifiers are per-deployment and do NOT match the R1 (ALTO) catalog — ids collide onto different cubes. A null dataset_uuid means no dashboard in the sample referenced that dataset; charts on it cannot import until it is filled in.

metric_sql.Reboot Count: SUM(CASE WHEN eventCode ='301' OR eventCode= '302' OR reason ='AP Restart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

metric_sql.AP Uptime: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN connectionStatus ='Online' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(debug_count),0),0)
metric_sql.Offline: COUNT(DISTINCT(apMac)) FILTER(WHERE connectionStatus IS NULL OR connectionStatus<>'Online')
metric_sql.Always Online: COUNT(DISTINCT(apMac)) - COUNT(DISTINCT(apMac)) FILTER(WHERE connectionStatus IS NULL OR connectionStatus<>'Online')
metric_sql.Ever Offline: COUNT(DISTINCT(apMac)) FILTER(WHERE connectionStatus IS NULL OR connectionStatus<>'Online')

metric_sql.Data Frame Ratio (Total): ROUND(CAST(((SUM(txDataFrames) +SUM(rxDataFrames))/ CAST(SUM(txMgmtFrames) + SUM(rxMgmtFrames)+ SUM(txDataFrames) + SUM(rxDataFrames) AS DECIMAL(3,2))) AS DECIMAL(2,2)),4)
metric_sql.Mgmt Frame Ratio (Total): ROUND(CAST(((SUM(txMgmtFrames) + SUM(rxMgmtFrames))/ CAST(SUM(txMgmtFrames) + SUM(rxMgmtFrames)+ SUM(txDataFrames) + SUM(rxDataFrames) AS DECIMAL(3,2))) AS DECIMAL(2,2)),4)
metric_sql.Avg AP-to-SZ Ping Latency: CASE WHEN AVG(pingLatency) <= 0 OR COUNT(pingLatency) <=0 THEN NULL ELSE AVG(pingLatency) FILTER(WHERE pingLatency > 0) END
metric_sql.Avg AP-to-Client Latency: CASE WHEN AVG(latency) <= 0 OR COUNT(latency) <=0 THEN NULL ELSE AVG(latency) FILTER(WHERE latency > 0) END
metric_sql.Avg AP-to-SZ Heartbeat Latency: CASE WHEN AVG(heartbeatLatency) <= 0 OR COUNT(heartbeatLatency) <=0 THEN NULL ELSE AVG(heartbeatLatency) FILTER(WHERE heartbeatLatency > 0) END
metric_sql.Avg AP Downlink Throughput: AVG(capacity*1024*1024) FILTER(WHERE radio IN ('2.4', '5', '6(5)') AND capacity > 0)

metric_sql.Avg Airtime Tx: CASE WHEN COUNT(airtimeTx) > 0 THEN CAST(AVG(airtimeTx) FILTER(WHERE airtimeUtilization > 0 OR airtimeIdle > 0)/100 AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END
metric_sql.Avg Airtime Rx: CASE WHEN COUNT(airtimeRx) > 0 THEN CAST(AVG(airtimeRx) FILTER(WHERE airtimeUtilization > 0 OR airtimeIdle > 0)/100 AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END
metric_sql.Avg Airtime Utilization: CASE WHEN COUNT(airtimeUtilization) > 0 THEN CAST(AVG(airtimeUtilization) FILTER(WHERE airtimeUtilization > 0 OR airtimeIdle > 0)/100 AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END
metric_sql.Avg Tx Retry Rate: CASE WHEN COUNT(txPktRetryRate) > 0 THEN CAST(AVG(txPktRetryRate)/100 AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END
metric_sql.Avg Airtime Busy: CASE WHEN COUNT(airtimeBusy) > 0 THEN CAST(AVG(airtimeBusy) FILTER(WHERE airtimeUtilization > 0 OR airtimeIdle > 0)/100 AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END
metric_sql.Avg Airtime Idle: CASE WHEN COUNT(airtimeIdle) > 0 THEN CAST(AVG(airtimeIdle) FILTER(WHERE airtimeUtilization > 0 OR airtimeIdle > 0)/100 AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END
metric_sql.Avg CPU Utilization: CASE WHEN COUNT(cpuPercentage) > 0 THEN CAST(AVG(cpuPercentage) AS FLOAT)/100 ELSE NULL END
metric_sql.Avg Memory Utilization: CASE WHEN COUNT(freeMemoryPercentage) > 0 THEN 1 - CAST(AVG(freeMemoryPercentage) AS FLOAT)/100 ELSE NULL END
metric_sql.Avg Storage Utilization: CASE WHEN COUNT(freeStoragePercentage) > 0 THEN 1 - CAST(AVG(freeStoragePercentage) AS FLOAT)/100 ELSE NULL END
metric_sql.Avg Tx Rate: CASE WHEN COUNT(txRateKbps) > 0 THEN AVG(txRateKbps * 1024) ELSE NULL END
metric_sql.Avg Rx Rate: CASE WHEN COUNT(rxRateKbps) > 0 THEN AVG(rxRateKbps * 1024) ELSE NULL END

metric_sql.Client Throughput: COALESCE((SUM(throughputEstimate) FILTER(WHERE throughputEstimate > 0) / NULLIF(SUM(debug_count) FILTER(WHERE throughputEstimate > 0), 0))*1024, NULL)
metric_sql.Avg RSS: COALESCE(FLOOR(SUM(lastRss) FILTER(WHERE lastRss < 0) / NULLIF(SUM(debug_count) FILTER(WHERE lastRss < 0), 0)), NULL)
metric_sql.Avg SNR: COALESCE(CEIL(SUM(lastSnr) FILTER(WHERE lastSnr > 0) / NULLIF(SUM(debug_count) FILTER(WHERE lastSnr > 0),0)), NULL)
metric_sql.Avg Noise Floor: COALESCE(CEIL(SUM(noiseFloor) FILTER(WHERE noiseFloor < 0) / NULLIF(SUM(debug_count) FILTER(WHERE noiseFloor < 0),0)), NULL)

metric_sql.Avg CPU Utilization: CASE WHEN SUM(debug_count) = 0 OR COUNT(cpuUtilization) <= 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(SUM(cpuUtilization)/SUM(debug_count) AS FLOAT) / 100 END
metric_sql.Avg Memory Utilization: CASE WHEN SUM(debug_count) = 0 OR COUNT(memoryUtilization) <= 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(SUM(memoryUtilization)/SUM(debug_count) AS FLOAT) / 100 END
metric_sql.Avg Disk Utilization: CASE WHEN SUM(debug_count) = 0 OR COUNT(diskUtilization) <= 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(SUM(diskUtilization)/SUM(debug_count) AS FLOAT) / 100 END

metric_sql.PoE Utilization (%): CASE WHEN SUM(poeTotal) = 0 AND SUM(poeUtilization) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN SUM(debug_count) = 0 OR COUNT(poeUtilization)<=0 OR COUNT(poeTotal)<=0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(SUM(poeUtilization)/SUM(debug_count) AS FLOAT)/CAST(SUM(poeTotal)/SUM(debug_count) AS FLOAT) END
metric_sql.CPU (%): CASE WHEN SUM(debug_count) = 0 OR COUNT(switchCpu) <= 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(SUM(switchCpu)/SUM(debug_count) AS FLOAT)/100 END
metric_sql.Memory (%): CASE WHEN SUM(debug_count) = 0 OR COUNT(switchMemory) <= 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(SUM(switchMemory)/SUM(debug_count) AS FLOAT)/100 END
metric_sql.Offline: COUNT(DISTINCT(switchId)) FILTER(WHERE switchStatus IS NULL OR switchStatus<>'ONLINE')
metric_sql.Always Online: COUNT(DISTINCT(switchId)) - COUNT(DISTINCT(switchId)) FILTER(WHERE switchStatus IS NULL OR switchStatus<>'ONLINE')
metric_sql.Ever Offline: COUNT(DISTINCT(switchId)) FILTER(WHERE switchStatus IS NULL OR switchStatus<>'ONLINE')

metric_sql.Port PoE Utilization (%): CASE WHEN SUM(debug_count) = 0 OR COUNT(portPoeUtilization) <= 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(SUM(portPoeUtilization)/SUM(debug_count) AS FLOAT)/100 END
metric_sql.Offline: COUNT(DISTINCT(switchId)) FILTER(WHERE switchStatus IS NULL OR switchStatus<>'ONLINE')
metric_sql.Always Online: COUNT(DISTINCT(switchId)) - COUNT(DISTINCT(switchId)) FILTER(WHERE switchStatus IS NULL OR switchStatus<>'ONLINE')
metric_sql.Ever Offline: COUNT(DISTINCT(switchId)) FILTER(WHERE switchStatus IS NULL OR switchStatus<>'ONLINE')
